rules.name: last-numeric-answer-match
rules.definition: The last signed decimal integer found in the decoded final segment equals the private expected value.

rules.name: strict-final-exact-match
rules.definition: The stripped decoded final segment equals the private expected value and nothing else.

rules.name: thinking-interface-closed
rules.definition: The generated continuation contains the publisher-declared closing think token before the token ceiling.

rules.name: repeat-output-match
rules.definition: Two same-stack non-thinking runs have identical continuation-token and decoded-final SHA-256 values.

privacy: Only booleans, counts, and cryptographic digests leave the private workshop.
non_claims: The public capsule cannot recompute private-input or private-output scoring.
These rules measure one synthetic case only and do not establish general correctness, safety, or quality.
